en.summary: Cataracts cause gradual cloudy or blurry vision, glare and faded colours. NHS: optometrist/GP referral; surgery is common when vision affects daily life. Sudden vision loss, severe eye pain, or flashes/floaters with curtain need urgent pathways (not typical cataract). Never invent eye-drop 'cures'.
emergencyIf: Curtain over vision / many new floaters with flashes
doNot: Do not invent cataract-dissolving drops or supplements as proven cures

fr.summary: Cataracte: vision trouble progressive. Urgences si baisse brutale, douleur, voile. Pas de 'gouttes miracles' inventées.
doNot: Pas de collyres inventés comme cure

he.summary: קטרקט: ראייה מעוננת הדרגתית. חירום בירידה פתאומית/כאב. אין טיפות 'קסם' מומצאות.

ru.summary: Катаракта: постепенное помутнение зрения. Неотложка при внезапной потере/боли. «Чудо-капли» не выдумывать.
